defect_theorem.admission: A legal repair moves the defect from j to k exactly when s*(N_j-N_k)=1.
defect_theorem.cost: At most3 accepted repairs; each lowers centered load-square by2.
defect_theorem.form: During settlement after sign s at port i, the state is the original settled N plus s*e_j at one moving port j.
defect_theorem.routing: Uniform among those legal neighbors; independent of rejected proposal counts.

preparation.alphabet: Exactly24 atomic events (port i, sign s), i in0..11 and s in{-1,+1}.
preparation.reference: Uniform counting on this declared complete event alphabet.
preparation.status: Source-allowed conditional renewal protocol; source grammar does not select this driving schedule.
preparation.temporal: Fresh event choice only after the preceding repair has settled; no correlations or additional preparation constraints.

readout.Q_covariance: E[Q tensor Q]=(E tr(Q^2)/5)*I5 in a Frobenius-orthonormal basis.
readout.averaging_boundary: Every A5-equivariant End(P3) readout averaged in this law is scalar, even when nonlinear. Individual sampled spectra are distinct from spectra of the averaged response.
readout.non_Gaussian_test: Compare E[(tr Q^2)^2] with (7/5)*(E tr Q^2)^2, the radial fourth moment of an isotropic centered Gaussian in five dimensions.
readout.odd_moments: Sign reversal forces all odd centered-count moments, including E tr(Q^3), to vanish.
readout.port_covariance: Centered count covariance decomposes as b3*P3+b3prime*P3prime+b5*P5.
readout.quadrupole: Q(N)=sum_i N_i*(n_i*n_i^T-I/3), unit icosahedral vectors n_i.

repair.completion: Complete native repair before the next preparation event.
repair.move: If N_i-N_j>=2 on a seam, transfer one whole record from i to j.
repair.physical_clock: No physical duration, Poisson clock or energy assigned.
repair.scheduler: Fresh uniform30-seam proposals; rejected proposals leave counts unchanged.

state.mass_normalization_boundary: Only shift-invariant observables have this stationary law. A Higgs or mass map depending on the mean count still needs a law for the unbounded protected total; a common shift is not assumed to be a physical gauge equivalence.
state.projection_boundary: This is a relative-count readout projection, not identification of different protected totals as physically identical.
state.space: All signed integer settled counts, projected modulo uniform integer translations by subtracting the minimum.
state.unquotiented_total: S changes by independent equiprobable+1 or-1. It has no normalizable stationary law on the integers.

stationarity.balance: Mean centered-square injection11/12 and decrease2 per repair force mean accepted repairs11/24.
stationarity.convergence: Unique positive stationary law; Cesaro means converge. Stepwise convergence from a single parity class is not asserted.
stationarity.detailed_balance: Test exact stationary edge flows; a nonzero current forbids identifying this driven law with a reversible equilibrium process.
stationarity.irreducibility: Direct removal at a global maximum remains settled; repetition reaches zero. Reverse direct additions give positive-probability paths.
stationarity.orbit_lift: A5 invariance gives per-state weight equal to orbit weight divided by orbit size.
stationarity.period_reason: Total-residue parity flips each renewal and direct edges have positive-probability two-cycles.
